scope: Atomic fit-up, butt welding, joint-level NDT and recording of 16 explicitly identified steel process-pipe joints, outside diameter 219 mm, wall 8 mm, steel 09G2S, under an explicitly selected WPS. Full pipe length, fittings, supports and whole-pipeline pressure testing are excluded.
sourceAuthority: Approved process-piping project organization, welding engineer, quality-control service and approving project engineer
projectDocumentsRequired: approved WPS with exact identity and consumable designations
welding-wire and shielding-gas supplier pack sizes and approved retained reserves
resource schedule for degreaser and grinding discs
method statement with fitter-welder labor, welding source, clamp and grinder quantities
NDT program with inspector labor, instrument quantities and report schedule
conditional root-purge, heat-treatment and coating-repair schedules
forbiddenClaims: automatic WPS, welding process or NDT method selection
universal consumable, labor, equipment, inspection or logistics productivity
full pipe length, fittings, supports or whole-pipeline pressure testing included
